end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea that earthworms make holes in soil, which can help water enter. Pihu first repeated that earthworms harm crops, then considered the helpful role and suggested that their holes let water in; the idea was not fully explained back. The lesson ended when Pihu said they were tired and had a headache. At home, you can ask Pihu to draw an earthworm tunnel and label how water enters the soil.
